spans.s:
उशत् mfn. (-शन्-शती-शत्) Inauspicious, (as discourse.)
 E. उष् to burn,
शतृ part. affix; also उषत्.
उषत् mfn. (-षन्-षती-षत्) Inauspicious, (as discourse:) see उशत्.

उशनस् m. (-नाः) A name of SUKRA, regent of the planet Venus.
 E. वस्
to wish, कनसि Unādi aff.

उष r. 1st cl. (ओषति) To burn. (उ,) उषु (ओषति) To kill or injure: with प्र
prefixed, this root makes प्रोषति, &c.

उष m. (-षः)
 1. Early morning, dawn, day-break.
 2. A libidinous man.
3.

Bdellium.
 4

. Saline earth.
 f. (-षा)
 1. A cow.
 2. Burning, scorch-
ing.
 3. A proper name, the wife of

ANIRUDDHA.
 4

Night.
 5

. A
pot; also उखा. ind. The end of night or day-break.
 E. उष् to burn,
क affix and fem. do टाप्; the affix of the particle is का.
ऊष r. 1st cl. (ऊषति) To be diseased or disordered.

ऊष m. (-षः) Salt-ground, soil impregnated with saline particles.
 n. (-षं)
Dawn, day-break.
 f. (-षा) The wife of ANIRUDDHA.
 E. ऊष् to be or
make sick, क affix, fem. टाप्: see उषा.

उषण n. (-णं) Black pepper.
 f. (-णा)
 1. Long pepper.
 2. Chai, (Piper
Chaba.)
 3. Dried ginger.
 E. उष् to burn, कनच् aff.

ऊषण n. (-णं) Black pepper.
 f. (-णा) Long pepper: see उषण.

उषप m. (-पः)
 1. The sun.
 2. Fire.
 E. उष् to burn, पच् aff.

उषर्बुध m. (-धः) Fire.
 E. उषस् dawn, बुध् to know, क aff.

उषस् n. (-षः)
 1. The dawn, morning.
 f. (-सी) The end of the day, twi-
light.
 E. उष् to burn, असि Unādi aff.

उषस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Belonging to the dawn.
 E. उषस् and य aff.

उषाकल m. (-लः) A cock.
 E. उषा dawn, कल् to sound, अच् aff.

उषापति m. (-तिः) A name of ANIRUDDHA, the son of KĀMADEVA. E.
उषा and पति a lord, a master: the husband of USHA.

उषारमण m. (-णः) ANIRUDDHA: see the preceding.
 E. उषा and रमण a
husband, &c.
ऊषक n. (-कं) Dawn, day-break. E. As before, कन् added.

ऊषर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) A spot with saline soil.
 E. ऊष such soil, रच् aff.

ऊषवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Consisting of saline soil, (a place, &c.)
 E. ऊष
and poss. affix मतुप्.
